dashboard.description: Cost per m³ by plant, designs by lifecycle state, stale prices and expired tests will appear here once designs are evaluated.

studio.description: Evaluate an existing mix or generate a trial recommendation, step by step, with every number explained.

library.description: Approved, in-production and trial designs, with versions, trial results and lifecycle history.

insights.description: Price, test and strength changes that deserve a second look will be triaged here, never as interruptions.

savings.description: Theoretical, approved and realized savings are shown side by side and never added together.

materials.description: Add a sieve test for each aggregate to unlock blend optimization. Test freshness and drift appear here.

prices.description: One matrix of materials by plant, with history, stale-price flags and Excel paste.

plants.description: Plants, their location and ambient profile, and the materials priced at each.

rules.description: ACI and Jordanian code values with clause references. Every value stays unverified until a QC manager checks it.

imports.description: Bring existing approved mix designs in from a spreadsheet, then attest each one to make it a baseline.

settings.description: Tenant settings such as plant limit, stale-price threshold and number format.

shell.noNotificationsHint: Critical alerts about strength results and expired tests will appear here.
